🎰 Super Bonus

Deluxe Casino — Award & Verify Guide
This tab is a step-by-step reference for awarding and auditing the Deluxe Casino Cash Bonus directly in Casino Manager — it does not calculate anything. For customer-facing terms (deposit, rollover, max win, expiration), see the Bonus Details tab.

1. Awarding the Bonus (Clerkview)

1
Find the customer & open Award Bonus
Look up the customer's account in Deluxe Casino (Casino Manager). Click the 3 dots next to the account number and select "Award Bonus".
2A
Super Slots
Type: Slots Deposits  ·  Rollover Multiplier: 100  ·  Max Win Cap: $200  ·  Expires: 48 hours  ·  Available Games: Only Specified — Ultimate Golden Dragon Inferno  ·  Autoreleased: AUTO
⏱ 48 hours
2B
Super Table
Type: Deposits  ·  Rollover Multiplier: 200  ·  Max Win Cap: $200  ·  Expires: 7 days  ·  Available Games: Only Specified — American Blackjack  ·  Autoreleased: AUTO
⏱ 7 days

2. Customer Experience

3
Bonuses tab
Customers open the "BONUSES" tab in the Deluxe Casino lobby to see and use their active bonus.
4
Choose the game
The Bonuses tab shows the active bonus, past bonus history, and a "Games" dropdown to pick which eligible game to play the bonus cash on.
5
Bonus Mode notice
Once the game loads, a pop-up confirms the customer is playing in Bonus Mode.
6
Rollover completed
If the customer reaches the required rollover: "Congratulations, your maximum bonus of [amount] has been released. Thank you for being a loyal player, enjoy!" (winnings capped at Max Win).
7
Rollover not completed
If the bonus balance runs out before rollover is met: "Insufficient bonus balance. Please contact customer support if you have any questions or issues."

3. Verifying in the Back Office

8
View Bonus Report Info
From the same 3-dot menu on the player's account, select "View Bonus Report Info" for a full breakdown of every bonus awarded.
9
Bonus report table
Shows Bonus ID, Type (Slots/Table Deposits), Status (Active / Released / Lost / Cancelled), Amount, Rollover, Collected, % Collected, and Resolve Time (when it posted to GBS). Click the ⋮ menu on any row for "View Details" or "View Game Sessions".
10A
View Details
Shows the game chosen, the description (to match it with the GBS deposit), bonus type, status, and expiration — everything needed to confirm what was awarded.
10B
View Game Sessions
Shows the actual game session played against the bonus — bets, payout, and $ gain/loss for that session.
11
What it looks like in GBS
Once released, the bonus posts to GBS as a Credit Adjustment — the system auto-generates the description (e.g. "Deluxe Casino Super Bonus Win") and links back to the Bonus ID in the Reference field. This is separate from the free-text Description you type when awarding the bonus.
